note: German household electricity prices, transcribed from the named publications. Both include VAT, taxes, levies and the proportional standing charge. BDEW covers new-customer tariffs only (tariff products + basic supply, population-weighted, 3,500 kWh/a); Destatis is the average paid by all private consumers.

primary.basis: Average new-customer tariff, 3,500 kWh/a, incl. VAT and standing charge

reference.basis: Average paid by all private consumers, incl. taxes, levies and standing charge
reference.source_name: Destatis press release 345/2026: Household electricity prices, 1st half 2026
